title: Stationary Strings Theorem VIII: Falsifiable Predictions, 511 keV Spectral Band, and Uncertainty Quantification
description: Eighth link of the series (October 2026): BASE-STEP 136 mT sideband falsification pair (Test T20), ALPHA 1.05 T third-field prediction and ratio lock (Test T21), 511 keV photon-budget prediction band (Test T22), UQ sensitivities and independent 7-point cross-check. Full paper in Turkish and English. Tests T20-T22 run with the solver in the Paper V repository (stationary-strings-v).
